bounds_description: This model propagates direction only, across curated edges whose causal standing is at least mechanistically supported, to a maximum of four steps. It does not model magnitude, timing, dose, individual variation, interaction effects, or compensation. Correlational edges do not propagate at all, so a correlation can never appear here as a consequence. Where the model stops, it says so rather than extrapolating.
